scope: All desktop H5 pages; min-width: 1024px, hover: hover, pointer: fine. Football and morph are confined to the login artwork/divider.
implementation: Native CSS cursors when settled. A 280ms SVG path morph temporarily replaces the native cursor across the login divider; rapid reversal continues from the current contour. No continuous DOM follower.

hotspotVerification: Positions checked against SVG coordinates. Final perceived tip alignment and operating-system native cursor display require a visible desktop browser check; ordinary Playwright page screenshots omit the native cursor.

integration.importStyle: App effect calls platform-resolved components/auth-cursor mountCursorSkin; non-H5 module is a no-op. Login styles preserve native region defaults.
integration.disabledControls: Native disabled, disabled attribute, aria-disabled=true, existing Taro disabled class and no-drop show the coral unavailable skin; disabling or re-enabling a hovered control updates without pointer movement.
